intro.bio: I'm a software engineer who studied Computer Science and Classics at Harvard. Here are a few things I'm currently doing or have worked on! Scroll for music :)

jobs.role: Cloud Security Change Management Technology Intern
Alex Patel Fellow, CS61: Systems Programming and Machine Organization

items.title: Senior thesis → NAACL
items.text: Wrote/coded a senior thesis, which won highest honors and the best undergraduate thesis in Latin at Harvard, and published it at the North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (NAACL): "Augmenting Close Reading for Classical Latin using BERT for Intertextual Exploration."

items.title: The Hedera Project
items.text: Improving Latin and Greek vocabulary acquisition using digital humanities with Dr. Ivy Livingston and Harvard IT.

items.title: Center for Hellenic Studies
items.text: Constructed and analyzed term-document ontology visualizations of the Ancient Greek works of Hippocrates through NLP (and latent semantic indexing) in R with Professor Mark Schiefsky and Dr. Said-Esteban Belmehdi.

items.title: Intertext.AI
items.text: Senior thesis/NAACL publication: a novel LLM-augmented interface that assists classicists in finding intertextual allusions among Latin texts.

items.title: Hedera
items.text: A digital humanities platform for beginner Latin students to develop vocabulary acquisition and reading comprehension via lemmatization support and progressively difficult texts.

items.title: AWS Security Group Remediation
items.text: Built and unit-tested AWS EC2 security group rule remediation script in Python using Boto3 SDK.

items.title: Continuo
items.text: President of Continuo from 2021-2023. Created new executive team structure and partnerships, including with Harvard Office of the Arts, and oversaw community performances.

items.title: Oboe
items.text: I play the oboe, previously in the [Harvard-Radcliffe Orchestra](https://www.harvardradcliffeorchestra.org/), previously with Continuo, once for the [Mexican Ambassador](https://www.instagram.com/p/CgksLsPpUlN/) to the US!
